format: NDCA Pro/Am, age or gender categories

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Pro/Am competitions may offer divisions including 'separate or merged categories by age or gender, etc.'

requirement: A future NDCA Pro/Am profile may let organizers offer separate or merged age or gender categories; it is discretionary.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: gender collection, columns, migrations, role-lock enforcement, UI. (Discretionary: the option itself is not a mandatory requirement; the blocker applies to correct handling if offered.)
interpretation_notes: Permissive ('may'). If an organizer offers gender categories, gender data would be needed (OD27-DF-0002). How the gender categories sit with the sex-or-gender-neutral couple definition in II.A.7.a is not explained in the text read; do not choose an interpretation.
